summary: Merged first-property plan for CopperBay. Latest calls supersede earlier positions: assign leads to the agent with the fewest leads; use Market Rent for GPR; allow partial resident payments at go-live; use current lease rent plus a 15% month-to-month premium for conventional properties; omit month-to-month at workforce properties; do not require a separate affordable certification approval; and use an open Work Done maintenance status before office completion. CopperBay will use Entrata’s affordable framework for local workforce programs, but the calls do not establish federal LIHTC participation.

settings.setting: Keep full administrators limited and create permanent operations and accounting administration coverage
settings.path: Setup >> Users & Groups >> Users >> Add New User
settings.proposed: Keep unrestricted access to a small group; create at least one permanent Operations Admin and one Accounting Admin. Use the reusable accounting/controller role for Brenda unless full Accounting Admin access is proven necessary.
settings.meaning: Avoids using unrestricted administrator access for every power user.
settings.assumption: Nicole’s implementation access and Michaela’s temporary elevation will be reviewed after go-live.

options.effect: Provides dedicated operating and accounting administrators.

reasoning: Matt approved only limited full-administrator access and requested an administrator-like role without accounting access.
Later calls favored a reusable accounting/controller role for Brenda rather than one-off unrestricted access.
